entries.note: A transit row, typed "OUT-Scan": the air waybill left the office named last for the one named first. The adapter words it "Out To …".
A transit row, typed "IN-Scan": the office named last received the air waybill, the delivering hub included. The adapter words it "Inward At …".
The status line once the delivery is recorded, with the day and the delivering branch.
The adapter's wording for the booking, from the booking office, day and clock above the tables.
